scope: Deterministic B2/B3 report only; production schemas compared read-only. No tests or scientific calls executed by reviewer.

findings.summary: Cross-host observations are checked but cannot discharge exact non-native wait closure.
findings.detail: wait_closed unconditionally calls gone on the current host. additional_host_observations are independently loaded but not matched to outer, DINO or metric wait descriptors. A valid score/DINO execution on another authorized GPU host will fail despite a matching closed-host observation.
findings.requested: Use an exact descriptor-bound host observation only for the corresponding cross-host wait and launch, preserving child/parent/host/flags checks; require same-host live refresh. Do not interpret remote PID in local /proc.

findings.summary: Unknown failures at current phase roots and DINO worker root are not explicitly rejected.
findings.detail: The report checks transport role failures, native controls and native rx failures, and waits. It does not inspect L/b2b3_analysis_v1/{B2,B3}/failure.json or L/b2b3_analysis_v1/B2/dino[/worker]/failure.json. A known zero-science preparation failure already exists and must be preserved; a generic omission also permits unrelated future failure metadata to go unnoticed.
findings.requested: Inspect exact current failure locations and allow only explicitly root-authorized, SHA/bytes-matched known engineering failures. Retain them in report provenance; unknown or altered failure files must stop. No blanket suppression or deletion.
